proxy_rationale: A deterministic, purpose-created, CC0 proxy corpus (reproducible spec-hashes, NO binaries committed) fixes the 72-identity contract and lets the scanner task, schedule, BIDS and dry-run pipelines be validated bit-deterministically WITHOUT any restricted media.
final_stimulus_set_requirement: Before acquisition the 72 proxy entries MUST be replaced 1:1 (same IDs, count, presentation timing) by the genuine naturalistic-video set for the C3XRP paradigm — either the original study's stimuli under license, or a purpose-created openly-licensed naturalistic set matched on duration/resolution/fps/codec. This is a LOUD, declared replacement, NOT a silent substitution: the readiness decision lists it as a named external prerequisite.
note: If no legal naturalistic set can be licensed or produced at acquisition time, the correct outcome is C3XRA_BLOCKED_STIMULUS_PROVENANCE — recorded here as the fail-closed rule.
